text:
LocalSubmissionPlanner.prepareLocal now takes an attempt epoch (defaulted to AttemptEpoch.initial, so every existing call site still compiles) and stages into ${attemptId}-e${epoch}, mirroring the worker's result layout. The attempt identity stays stable across epochs -- that is what an epoch is for -- while each epoch owns its own private directory, so a resubmission can no longer overwrite the previous attempt's stdout and stderr. LogRef now carries the real epoch instead of always AttemptEpoch.initial.

Evidence: new LocalSubmissionPlannerSuite test prepares the same request at epochs 1 and 2, asserts a shared attempt id, distinct log paths, correct LogRef epochs, and that both attempts' logs remain independently readable after the resubmission. local 25/25.
